You see the world board.
This board will notify you of currently active mini world changes all over Tibia.

Location

Adventurer's Guild floor +1, near Charos.

Notes

When used, it will print information about currently active Mini World Changes in the Server Log.

Possible messages are:

  • A fiery fury gate has opened near one of the major cities somewhere in Tibia. — Fury Gates is active.
  • A big iceberg has been washed up at the coast north of Port Hope. It seems to be inhabited by strange white furballs. — Chakoya Iceberg is active.
  • The wild animals north of the Green Claw Swamp clearly dominate the area. But poachers come here to hunt them. — Poacher Caves is active and game dominates.
  • Poachers are ravaging the wildlife north of the Green Claw Swamp. But the animals seem to fight back! — Poacher Caves is active and Poachers dominate.
  • Poachers have slaughtered nearly all wild animals north of the Green Claw Swamp. But vengeful spirits show up there now! — Poacher Caves is active and Ghost Wolves dominate.
  • A hive infestation has been sighted south-west of Liberty Bay! An unnerving humming and buzzing is filling the air. — Hive Outpost is active.
  • Strange sounds echo through Trapwood as hunters and dworcs fight over the holy grounds and the game that roams there. — Jungle Camp is active.
  • A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the northernmost coast! — Nightmare Isles is active and its portal is located at Darama's northernmost coast.
  • A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the river near Drefia! — Nightmare Isles is active and its portal is located close to the river near Drefia.
  • A sandstorm travels through Darama, leading to isles full of deadly creatures inside a nightmare. Avoid the Ankrahmun tar pits! — Nightmare Isles is active and its portal is located close to Ankhramun tar pits.
  • The full moon has a strange impact on the island of Grimvale. The small forest there seems darker, filled with nightly howls. — Grimvale is active.
  • Stampede! The Ape God has stirred up Tiquanda's elephants again! — Stampede is active.
  • Several banks in major coastal towns are being robbed! The thieves are still on the loose! — Bank Robbery is active.
  • Nomads travel the eternal sands of Ankrahmun's desert. There must be a camp somewhere. — Nomads is active.
  • Judging by the unnerved mammoths in Svargrond, enough snow has melted away to reveal some very special flora. — Thawing is active.
  • The river in Zao Steppe runs deep, there may be more fish than usual! — River Runs Deep is active.
  • Not again! Noodles has taken some royal freedom and left the castle, after him in the name of the king! — Noodles is Gone is active.
  • Oriental ships sighted! A trader for exotic creature products may currently be visiting Carlin, Ankrahmun or Liberty Bay. — Oriental Trader is active.
  • Looks like the Queen's own royal trees are being cut down! The lumberjacks responsible shall be put to justice. — Lumberjack is active.
  • The volcano on Goroma sends its fiery message into the sky. A lot of creatures are flooding the lands together with its lava. — Fire from the Earth is active.
  • Hail to the King! It's Kingsday in Thais, join the celebration! — Kingsday is active.
  • The river south of the outlaw camp is flooding. A small island there should now be reachable safely. — Down the Drain is active.
  • Sharpen your sword! The witch Wyda seems to be bored so pay her a visit! — Bored is active.
  • Bibby Bloodbath and her crew are roaming the lands, destroying everything in their path. — Warpath is active.
  • A whole nest of spiders needs to be exterminated as Mamma Longlegs is on the loose. — Spider Nest is active.
  • In case you have some spare tentacle pieces, you can now use Devovorga's very essence to enter a boss lair! — Devovorga's Essence is active.
  • An ice bridge now connects Svargrond to a frosty island, where monsters and a strange frozen creature have been sighted. — Chyllfroest is active.
  • Adventurers have told of a Spirit Gate in the Daramian mountains. Fight the restless undead! — Spirit Grounds is active at Darama.
  • Adventurers have told of a Spirit Gate in the Ghostlands. Fight the restless undead! — Spirit Grounds is active at Ghostlands.
  • Adventurers have told of a Spirit Gate in Vengoth. Fight the restless undead! — Spirit Grounds is active at Vengoth.
